subject: Medspectra evaluation kickoff & dataset format
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@medspectra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Medspectra evaluation kickoff & dataset format

Evan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap + proposed next steps so we can get your evaluation running on Redwood ASAP.

Recap (1 min):
- Goal: validate model-fit for two primary flows — (A) clinical triage classification (single-label), (B) encounter summarization (abstractive).
- Success criteria: classification F1 >= 0.82 on held-out test; summarization ROUGE-L delta < -0.05 vs baseline (we'll refine thresholds after a first run).
- Constraints: PHI in some fields, you prefer that evaluation runs in our Dedicated/VPC workspace or on S3 with dataset hashing — we'll confirm.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You share a small sample (<= 2k rows) with IDs, inputs, and ground-truths — see sample CSV attached (medspectra_eval_dataset_sample.csv). Format notes below.
2) We provide recommended model candidates and a scoring rubric — attached (redwood_model_recs.pdf, scoring_rubric_v1.csv).
3) Kickoff a 60-min technical run-through next week to confirm ingestion path (S3 or VPC), masking/PII handling, and timeline for full-scale run.

Dataset format (attached sample shows exact column names):
- id: unique string
- text_input: raw prompt / encounter text to evaluate
- task: "triage" or "summary"
- reference: for triage -> label; for summary -> reference_summary
- metadata: patient_age, dept, anonymized_patient_id (optional)

Scoring & runner:
- We'll run classification with standard precision/recall/F1 (micro + macro) and summarization with ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and a manual sample pass for safety-critical cases.
- We recommend starting with two model families: RW-Chat-7B-v2-q4 (fast, low cost) and OpenLlama-13B-ffn (higher context/quality). Full list + estimated cost/latency in redwood_model_recs.pdf.

Attachments included: medspectra_eval_dataset_sample.csv, redwood_model_recs.pdf, scoring_rubric_v1.csv, prompt_set_v1.json

Timeline suggestion: sample dataset today, kickoff next Tue 11/24 or Wed 11/25, first 2k-run within 48 hours of ingestion.

Questions for you now:
- Preferred host for evaluation run: Hosted (Redwood hosted), Dedicated (reserved capacity), or Private (VPC/on-prem)?
- Any red-lines on data retention after the run (we default to 30 days unless you request deletion/air-gapped handling)?

Thanks — I’ll hold time for Tue/Wed options and Ben will prep an infra checklist.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Attachment: medspectra_eval_dataset_sample.csv (CSV stub, 3 rows)
Attachment: redwood_model_recs.pdf (summary of recommended candidate models and perf estimates)

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@medspectra.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medspectra.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medspectra evaluation kickoff & dataset format

Thanks Jasmine — helpful recap. A few quick answers and a couple of asks.

Answers:
- Preferred host: we want to avoid moving PHI outside our VPC unless absolutely necessary. Can Redwood run the eval inside our VPC (Dedicated) or do you need us to provide an export with deterministic hashing?
- Retention: 30 days default is fine, but procurement will want a written deletion attestation after the evaluation.

Asks:
- Can you confirm whether "RW-Chat-7B-v2-q4" supports 8k context for our longer encounters? Some of the notes run long.
- On scoring, we want a per-case flagging column for safety issues (hallucination / PHI leakage). If the model invents a diagnosis or includes a real patient identifier that wasn't in the input, we need it surfaced.

We uploaded a 500-row sample to our sandbox S3: s3://medspectra-sandbox/eval_samples/20261119_sample.csv — it follows your sample CSV schema. We'd prefer the kickoff Wed 11/25 morning Pacific.

cc: Priya (clinical lead) who will review scoring rubric.

—
Evan Brooks
Head of Product
Medspectra Health
evan.brooks@medspectra.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@medspectra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medspectra evaluation kickoff & dataset format

Evan — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the S3 link. Short answers and concrete next actions below.

VPC/Dedicated run: yes, we can run inside your Dedicated environment. Ben will coordinate the minimal IAM role and S3-read path (we do not copy data off VPC; the runner mounts directly). He'll share the infra checklist prior to kickoff.

Context window: RW-Chat-7B-v2-q4 supports up to 8k tokens in our optimized path; for >8k we recommend either chunked prompts with overlap for summarization or OpenLlama-13B (13B) which we can run in a larger-context mode on your Dedicated pool. See redwood_model_recs.pdf for measured latencies.

Safety flagging and quality regression monitoring:
- We'll produce per-case flags: hallucination_score (0-1), pii_exposure (boolean), confidence_margin. Flags are generated using a mix of model-based detectors + rule-based checks against input/reference.
- For regression monitoring we recommend a baseline snapshot run (your current baseline model) + the candidate models. We compute delta metrics and push alerts if classification F1 drops > 3 points or if pii_exposure rate increases by > 0.5%.

Dataset & scoring specifics (confirm these are implemented by your team):
- CSV columns: id, task, text_input, reference, patient_age, encounter_date, anonymized_patient_id
- For summarization references we expect ~1 reference summary per row; if you have multiple references, include them as reference_1, reference_2 columns.
- Missing labels: mark as NA; Redwood ignores NA rows for aggregated scoring but we keep them in the per-case report.

Attachments & runner artifacts we'll provide at kickoff: prompt_set_v1.json (seed prompts + temperature settings), scoring_rubric_v1.csv (per-task metric weights), and an evaluation notebook to reproduce local scoring.

Next steps (action owners):
- Ben: share Dedicated infra checklist + IAM role by EOD Tue 11/24.
- Priya / Medspectra: confirm remediation window for deletion attestation (30 days + attestation doc).
- Jasmine: schedule the Wed 11/25 09:30 PT kickoff; prepare model candidates and cost estimates.

If that's all good we'll lock the 11/25 time.

—
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

2) Coverage for long notes: where chunking is used, will summarization quality metrics be reported at the full-encounter level (we need one summary per encounter)?

Also attaching a tiny extracted sample (3 rows) from our sandbox for your ingestion team to sanity-check. Link: s3://medspectra-sandbox/eval_samples/20261119_sample.csv (same as before).
